## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle *kēwén* 科文 (topical-outline) accompanying Lái Zhōu's eleven-fascicle *[Qiǎnzhù 淺註 (X367)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0011)* commentary on [T159](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0008). The *kēwén* genre is the standard East-Asian Buddhist diagrammatic-tabular outline of a *sūtra*'s structure: each section, sub-section, and clause is labelled with a tree-form numbering (○九, 二, 三 …), giving a complete topical map of the *sūtra* organised hierarchically. The *kēwén* is normally read alongside the line-by-line commentary, whose section-divisions correspond to the *kēwén*'s nodes.

**Abstract**

The *Kēwén* gives the explicit topical-outline structure that the line-by-line *Qiǎnzhù* assumes; it is the navigational armature of the commentary. The outline divides the *sūtra* into its *xù* 序 / *zhèng* 正 / *liútōng* 流通 sections in the standard Chinese Buddhist exegetical scheme, then sub-divides each chapter and verse-paragraph into its constituent topical units. This work is therefore not exegetical in its own right but is the indispensable companion-text by which the *Qiǎnzhù*'s commentarial divisions are read.
